name: István Kovács
bio:
István's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at Budapest University of Technology and Economics, a friend dragged him along to a local hill climb event. The roar of the engines and the raw engineering on display captivated him. He swiftly shifted his focus to automotive design, landing an internship at a small racing team shortly after graduation. Over the years, István honed his technical skills and developed a knack for identifying inefficiencies and bottlenecks within team operations.

His approach as Head of Operations is rooted in meticulous planning and clear communication. He believes that a well-structured team, where everyone understands their role and responsibilities, is crucial for success. István is particularly adept at streamlining processes and ensuring that resources are allocated effectively. His blend of technical expertise and management acumen allows him to bridge the gap between the engineering department and the logistical side of the team, fostering a cohesive and productive environment. What sets István apart is his unwavering commitment to continuous improvement. He constantly seeks new ways to optimize performance, both on and off the track.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze, István carries himself with an air of quiet competence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and calculations.
Has a specific coffee blend he insists on having brewed every morning.
Known for meticulously cleaning his desk before leaving for the day.
